incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A collapsed multi-story building with debris scattered around, surrounded by other structures and vegetation in the background.

observations.description: A building is heavily damaged with its roof and walls collapsed, surrounded by rubble.
A utility pole stands near the collapsed building.
Trees are visible in the background and among the debris.
A white sack is visible in the foreground, near a damaged structure.
